crypto.remediation: pinned subset on browser (SHA-2 digests + random); full native set on native

kv.remediation: browser-local preview data; not durable or multi-user

postgres.remediation: deploy behind the native Velqu runtime with a linked Postgres pool; the browser target refuses this capability

payments.remediation: no Velqu payments capability exists; integrate via your own server

email.remediation: no Velqu email capability exists; integrate via your own server

webhooks.remediation: no Velqu webhooks capability exists; integrate via your own server

cron.remediation: no Velqu cron capability exists; use external scheduling against a deployed native service

queues.remediation: no Velqu durable-queue capability exists; defer is bounded in-memory best-effort, never a durable queue

__unknown__.remediation: unknown capability "totally-unknown" — unknown classifications fail closed (no handle, no simulation, no grant)
